game_title: Stack Of Plates – Broken Colonnade Race
game_concept: A adventure race set in Eldritch Ruins – Broken Colonnade, a row of broken columns: the relic hunter must handle ghost knights while practicing lists. Core idea – Stack Of Plates: Push and pop from the end of a list to handle last-in, first-out stacks.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Broken Colonnade: a row of broken columns
core_gameplay_loop: In Broken Colonnade, repeat each round: Push and pop from the end of a list to handle last-in, first-out stacks. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the relic hunter ahead. Then check the stack_balance value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the glyph door by solving code steps involving stack_balance that move the relic hunter forward.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.8).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the glyph door first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 7 (applied tier): Stack Of Plates
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Stack Of Plates' (Week 7 slot 5), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Broken Colonnade'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Eldritch Ruins

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how stack_balance changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against ghost knights in Broken Colonnade.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.8).
